title: Surface Measurement Systems
content: Surface Measurement Systems is a United Kingdom supplier of sorption science instrumentation for advanced materials characterization. The company supports research on porosity, vapor sorption, diffusion, and surface interactions in a range of porous materials applications. It is a relevant Equipment Materials listing for aerogel-related projects that require laboratory tools for sorption analysis and detailed material characterization.
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
